$comment: Shared between app_main/lib/features/games/engine/timeline_map_engine.dart and dashboard/api/src/lib/mapRegions.ts. The client draws and hit-tests with these bounds; the server uses them to reject an event whose coordinates fall outside the map the child will see. Both sides are asserted against this file so they cannot drift. A bounding box is a viewport and nothing else: no borders are derived from it.

distances_km.$comment: Baghdad to Cairo, great-circle. Checked against the haversine both implementations use.
A point to itself must be zero, not a rounding artefact.
Fez to Baghdad, spanning the whole MENA viewport.
